characteristics.name: Capacity
characteristics.$text: This model has a **Transport Capacity** of 6 however can not **transport** any model with a **Transport Space** greater then 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Models with this gain +1 **melee attacks** the turn they **charge** a **enemy unit** that is **pinned** and/or **battle-shocked**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If a model with this has **remained stationary** this turn add 1 to the number of **ranged attacks** it can make with **Bolter**s.
